== Summary ==
Identified: [[Justin Desai]] and [[Joe Olson]]. Remaining faces unlabeled.
Finalist Justin Desai plays Joe Olson in Game 6. Both reached the Top 8., at the [[2026 World Championship]] (Hyatt Regency Bloomington by Mall of America, Bloomington, Minnesota).
